Entry requirements · 2027 entry

Management BSc at London School of Economics

What London School of Economics asks of applicants to Management BSc for 2027 entry (the 2026–27 application cycle). Each requirement below is labelled verified, partly verified or not verified, with the date it was checked and a link to the official source.

UK · All London School of Economics courses · Business field guide

Entry requirements 2027 entry 8 of 8 verified
SAT / ACT
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma (the diploma alone is not sufficient): one accepted route for A*AA/AAA offers is a minimum High School Diploma GPA of 3.7 plus ACT 32+ or SAT 1450+, with AP Calculus BC at grade 5 because this programme requires Mathematics
  • SAT/ACT is not the only route: five APs at grade 5 with a GPA of 3.7 is the alternative
Verified19 Oct 2026LSE: United States of America (international students)
English language
  • IELTS Academic: 7.0 overall and 7.0 in each component (one sitting)
  • TOEFL iBT: 100 overall with at least 27 Writing, 25 Reading, 24 Listening, 24 Speaking (updated-scale tests from January 2026: 5.5 overall, 5 in each skill)
  • PTE Academic (in person only): 70 overall with 70 in all components
  • Cambridge C1 Advanced / C2 Proficiency: 185 overall and 185 in each component
  • Proof is needed only if LSE makes an offer; nationals of Canada or a UKVI majority English-speaking country whose first language is English are exempt
Verified19 Oct 2026LSE: English language requirements
Admissions tests

None listed on the official source

LSE’s entry-requirements page lists the TMUA as mandatory only for BSc Economics and BSc Econometrics and Mathematical Economics (recommended for eight other programmes, not this one) and the LNAT only for the LLB.

Verified19 Oct 2026LSE: Undergraduate entry requirements
Subject prerequisites
  • Required: Mathematics (A-level or equivalent)
  • Preferred: traditional academic subjects such as natural sciences, English, Economics and the humanities (over Business Studies or Accounting)

LSE also says Further Mathematics provides helpful preparation but is not essential.

Other qualifications
  • For applicants with a US high-school diploma:
    • five APs at grade 5, taken over a maximum of three years, plus a minimum High School Diploma GPA of 3.7 (A*AA/AAA level)
    • subjects may be specified in an offer
  • Mathematics requirement met with AP Calculus BC at grade 5
  • AP Seminar, AP Capstone and AP Research do not count; only one of AP Calculus AB/BC counts
Verified19 Oct 2026LSE: United States of America (international students)
Other requirements
  • Assessment uses the UCAS application: predicted/achieved grades, subjects and subject combinations, personal statement, teacher’s reference and educational circumstances
  • Some applicants with non-traditional or less well-known qualifications may be asked to sit LSE’s Undergraduate Admissions Assessment (UGAA)

The pages checked do not mention interviews.
